title: Contents Packout & Storage Vault Racking Charges for Crated Art, Mirrors and Glass
content:
Contents Packout & Storage crated art, mirrors and glass are kept on vault racking charged per crate for the period. On the vault storage billed to the customer on a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job: **when the crate quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the racking volume threshold, each crate is charged the volume racking rate; when they total at least one crate but fewer than the racking volume threshold, each crate is charged the standard racking rate; a job with no crate on its packout lines carries no racking.**

## Racking charge sheet

| Crates on the job's packout lines (total of the crate quantities) | Charge per crate for the period | Racking for the period |
|---|---|---|
| 4 or more (at least the racking volume threshold) | 14.00 (volume racking rate) | crates times 14.00 |
| 1 to 3 | 18.50 (standard racking rate) | crates times 18.50 |
| none | — | no racking |

The crates counted are the quantities on the custom crate packing lines booked on the job.

## Boundary cases

| Crates | Racking for the period |
|---|---|
| 3 | 3 times 18.50, or 55.50 |
| 4 | 4 times 14.00, or 56.00 |
| 9 | 9 times 14.00, or 126.00 |
| 0 | none |
